newsitem.title: CANADA: TVX to manage Valerie Gold site.
newsitem.headline: TVX to manage Valerie Gold site.

text.p: TVX Gold Inc will manage exploration and development at Valerie Gold Resources Ltd's Mamatla gold and silver property in Mexico, the companies said Thursday.
TVX assumes its management role immediately, they said.
Valerie Gold owns 85 percent of the propoerty.
The first year's exploration program on the property will cost about US$4.9 million with the possibility of an additional US$2 million for extra definition drilling, the companies said.
Work to date has identified silver, gold, zine and lead mineralization over a length of four km.
As part of the arrangements, TVX has been granted a right of first refusal to the Mamatla property.
